III – Foods and Fluids During Runs Longer than an Hour

Nancy Clark’s Food Guide for New Runners

Commercial Sports Foods
As a new runner, you likely feel confused by the plethora of commercial sports foods from which to choose.
A multitude of businesses have jumped on the bandwagon to create products that appeal to a variety of
runners, from those with special dietary requests (gluten-free, vegan) to those who are just plain hungry
and want a “politically correct” candy bar (Marathon Bar). 
When it comes to what to buy, there is no “best choice”; you simply need to experiment to determine what
products satisfy your taste buds and settle well. Most of the sports products claim to be easy to digest, but
you will have to determine that for yourself. Just keep in mind “real food” (dried figs, gummy bears,
chocolate milk) can often do the same job at a lower price. Commercial sports foods tend to be more
about convenience than necessity; they can make fueling easier for busy runners.
